methods.label: Check the angle sums
methods.explanation: Two angles whose measures add up to \(90^\circ\) are complementary, and \(30^\circ+60^\circ=90^\circ\). Both \(45^\circ+135^\circ\) and \(100^\circ+80^\circ\) equal \(180^\circ\), so these pairs are supplementary; \(20^\circ+80^\circ=100^\circ\).
methods.levelReason: The method uses the Grade 7 complement and supplement definitions with elementary addition.

candidate.annotationRationale: The assessed target is recognizing complementary angles, covered by cnm_059. The method checks every choice and distinguishes supplementary pairs using the same node.
